name: Schöppenstedt (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Schöppenstedt (two yellow leopards on red above a boat on blue waves).
history: Municipal flag of Schöppenstedt; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
